`mvn -q test` passes with exit code 0. Here's a summary of everything that was done:

---

## Summary

### Production code changes

1. **`MatrixService.java`** — Added `sum()` method that atomically sums all cells using `Math.addExact` (throws `ArithmeticException` on overflow).

2. **`MatrixController.java`** — Added `GET /api/matrix/sum` endpoint that delegates to `matrix.sum()`.

### Test files created

| File | #tests | What it covers |
|------|--------|----------------|
| `MatrixServiceTest.java` | 51 | Constructor validation (dimensions, MAX_SIZE), get/set with boundary cells and extreme values, add with overflow/underflow, clear, snapshot independence, `sum()`, error messages |
| `MatrixControllerTest.java` | 19 | Direct controller method calls for all endpoints, exception handler for all three exception types, null-message fallback |
| `MatrixPageControllerTest.java` | 7 | HTML structure (title, heading, table, row numbers, CSS classes positive/zero/negative, cell values) |
| `MatrixApiIntegrationTest.java` | 22 | Full HTTP integration via `RestTestClient` against running server (RANDOM_PORT): all REST CRUD endpoints, invalid cells (400), overflow/underflow (400), clear (204), HTML page, snapshot, `sum` endpoint, cleanup via `@BeforeEach` |

### Mutation testing (mutagate)

| Target | Score | Threshold | Status |
|--------|-------|-----------|--------|
| `MatrixService` | 0.92 (36/39) | 0.80 | **pass** — 3 equivalent mutants waived |
| `MatrixController` | 1.00 (10/10) | 0.80 | pass |
| `MatrixPageController` | 1.00 (7/7) | 0.80 | pass |

The 3 survivors in `MatrixService.cell()` are all **equivalent mutants** — the second bounds check (`index >= cells.length`) is mathematically redundant given the first check (`row < rows && col < cols`), and only fires when the first check itself is mutated (which PIT never does simultaneously). Waivers have been proposed for human review.
